title.zh: Anthropic 的安全监督者，将向 Anthropic 收钱。

summary.en: A safety partnership puts independence on trial.
summary.zh: 一项安全合作，把独立性推上考场。

en: Anthropic will directly fund Accenture’s embedded evaluation work. Their September 18 announcement leaves access and reporting standards unsettled.
The two companies each expect to invest at least $1 billion over five years. Dario Amodei’s proposed reviewer contract would allow unfavorable findings to be published, with specified redactions.
The question worth following: when a finding hurts the payer, does it reach the public?
zh: Anthropic 将直接资助埃森哲的驻场评估工作。9月18日的公告称，访问权限和报告标准仍未确定。
两家公司各自预计在五年内投入至少10亿美元。Dario Amodei 提出的评估合同方案允许公开不利结论，但保留特定删节权。
值得追问的是：当结论伤到付款方，公众还能读到吗？

wtf.zh: 被检查的一方，给检查者付钱。

consequence.en: Public trust will depend on evidence that survives commercial discomfort.
consequence.zh: 公众信任将取决于：令人商业上难堪的证据，能否公开。

uncertainty.en: Announced plans; spending and evaluator independence are not verified outcomes.
uncertainty.zh: 目前是已公布的计划；支出和评估独立性尚不是经过验证的结果。

sources.title: Anthropic: Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation
Dario Amodei: We Must Pace the Frontier
Anthropic: Improving our alignment and security efforts

claims.text: Anthropic announced direct funding for Accenture’s evaluation work; operating standards remain unsettled.
Each company expects at least $1bn of investment over five years; Faculty will lead Accenture’s work.
Amodei proposes employee-like reviewer access and publication rights with limited redactions; this is a stated intention.
Anthropic’s June policy proposal calls for external evaluation and government or pooled funding.
Anthropic says it paused evaluations and redirected roughly 150 product engineers to security-related work earlier in 2026.

hooks.en: Anthropic’s watchdog will invoice Anthropic.
hooks.zh: Anthropic 的监督者，将向 Anthropic 收钱。

hooks.en: Can a paid watchdog bite?
hooks.zh: 拿钱的监督者，还能咬下去吗？

hooks.en: The AI referees arrive before the rulebook.
hooks.zh: AI 裁判要来了，规则还没定。

hooks.en: Who watches the paid AI watchdog?
hooks.zh: 谁来监督收钱的 AI 监督者？

hooks.en: Two billion-dollar plans. One trust problem.
hooks.zh: 两份十亿美元计划，同一个信任难题。

hooks.en: AI safety gets a billion-dollar plan—twice.
hooks.zh: AI 安全收到十亿美元计划，一次还不够，是两次。

hooks.en: Meet the people hired to test Claude.
hooks.zh: 谁将受聘来检查 Claude？

hooks.en: Big safety plans. The verdict comes later.
hooks.zh: 安全计划很大，结果还得等。

hooks.en: Can reviewers publish what Anthropic hates?
hooks.zh: Anthropic 不喜欢的结论，评估者能公开吗？

hooks.en: AI’s outside reviewers are promised office badges.
hooks.zh: AI 的外部评估者，被承诺发办公门禁卡。

hooks.en: The revealing part may be what gets redacted.
hooks.zh: 最值得看的，也许是被删掉的部分。

hooks.en: A desk inside. A voice outside?
hooks.zh: 有内部工位，能向外说话吗？

hooks.en: Anthropic has another idea: pool the watchdog money.
hooks.zh: Anthropic 的另一个方案：监督经费统一筹集。

hooks.en: Who should grade an AI lab’s homework?
hooks.zh: AI 实验室的作业，该由谁打分？

hooks.en: AI oversight needs more than another promise.
hooks.zh: AI 监督，需要的岂止又一个承诺。

hooks.en: Who pays for an honest AI verdict?
hooks.zh: 一份诚实的 AI 评估，该由谁买单？

hooks.en: Anthropic says 150 engineers were reassigned for safety.
hooks.zh: Anthropic 称，150名工程师曾被调去做安全。

hooks.en: Before the watchdog: Anthropic’s testing pause.
hooks.zh: 监督者到来之前，Anthropic 先暂停过测试。

hooks.en: What does slowing an AI lab actually cost?
hooks.zh: 让 AI 实验室慢下来，代价究竟是什么？

hooks.en: The next AI safety story should contain evidence.
hooks.zh: 下一条 AI 安全新闻，该拿出证据了。

experiment.hypothesis: Untested editorial hypothesis: the concrete payer relationship earns more opens; publication rights may earn more completed reads. Scores are editorial guesses, not measured engagement.

x.en: Can a paid watchdog bite? Anthropic will fund Accenture’s evaluation work. Watch the first uncomfortable finding—and whether it becomes public.
x.zh: 拿钱的监督者，还能咬下去吗？Anthropic 将资助埃森哲的评估。值得盯的是第一份令人难堪的结论，以及它能否公开。

linkedin.en: Two firms each expect to invest at least $1bn in AI safety. The buyer’s question: what independent evidence will you receive before trusting the product?
linkedin.zh: 两家公司各自预计投入至少10亿美元做 AI 安全。买方该问：信任产品之前，我能拿到什么独立证据？

wechat.en: An office badge is access. Publication rights are power. Amodei proposes both for reviewers. The contract’s implementation is the story to follow.
wechat.zh: 门禁卡给的是访问权，公开结论给的是发声权。Amodei 打算两者都给外部评估者。真正该追的是：合同如何落地。

video.en: 0–5s: Show a blank invoice. ‘Can a watchdog bite the company paying it?’ 5–15s: Two company names. ‘Anthropic and Accenture each expect billion-dollar safety investments.’ 15–25s: Office badge, then black redaction bars. ‘Amodei proposes access for reviewers, and a right to publish findings—even unfavorable ones, subject to specified redactions.’ 25–40s: Empty evidence folder. ‘Their June framework called for broader funding. Their August account described engineering work redirected to safety. Now comes the test we can watch: what evidence actually reaches us?’
video.zh: 0–5秒：空白账单。‘监督者能咬向付钱的公司吗？’ 5–15秒：两家公司名称。‘Anthropic 和埃森哲，各自预计投入十亿美元做安全。’ 15–25秒：门禁卡，切到删节黑条。‘Amodei 提议让评估者进入公司，并允许公开不利结论，但有特定删节。’ 25–40秒：空证据文件夹。‘六月的框架提议更广泛筹款。八月的说明讲述了工程师转做安全。现在轮到我们能看见的考验：究竟有哪些证据会公开？’

title.en: Same-sized mirror. A hundred times the sky.
title.zh: 镜子一样大，视野却是100倍。

summary.en: Roman has launched. Its giant questions remain open.
summary.zh: 罗曼望远镜已升空，它追问的大问题仍没有答案。

en: NASA’s Roman telescope launched on August 30. Its mirror matches Hubble’s diameter, but its wide-field instrument covers roughly 100 times the sky area per image.
One planned survey should reveal more than a billion galaxies, helping test why cosmic expansion accelerates. Another search is expected to find roughly 100,000 planets through transits.
Those are forecasts. NASA’s launch announcement anticipated first images in early 2027. The machine is on its way; the discoveries still have to happen.
zh: NASA 的罗曼望远镜于8月30日发射。主镜直径与哈勃相同，但宽视场仪器每张图像覆盖的天空面积约为哈勃的100倍。
一项计划中的巡天预计能看到超过十亿个星系，帮助研究宇宙为何加速膨胀。另一项搜索预计通过凌星发现约十万颗行星。
这些仍是预期。NASA 在发射公告中预计2027年初发布首批图像。机器已经上路，发现仍待发生。

wtf.en: The mirror did not grow. The view did.
wtf.zh: 镜子没变大，视野却变了。

consequence.en: A wider census could change which cosmic stories survive the evidence.
consequence.zh: 更广泛的普查，可能改写哪些宇宙解释经得住证据。

uncertainty.en: Projected yields are not discoveries; early-2027 imagery was a launch-day forecast.
uncertainty.zh: 预期发现量不等于已发现；2027年初的图像时间表是发射时的预计。

sources.title: NASA: Core survey will explore the dark universe
NASA: Roman’s search for faraway worlds

claims.text: Roman launched August 30; the release forecast first images in early 2027 and roughly 1.4TB of daily data.
Roman and Hubble have equal primary-mirror diameters; Roman’s wide-field instrument covers about 100 times the sky area.
The planned wide-area survey targets over a billion galaxies to investigate dark matter and accelerating expansion.
Scientists forecast roughly 100,000 transiting planets; Roman data will be public.
Roman’s broad surveys and Webb’s detailed infrared observations have complementary scientific roles.

hooks.en: Same-sized mirror. A hundred times the sky.
hooks.zh: 镜子一样大，视野却是100倍。

hooks.en: NASA’s new telescope was built to lose tunnel vision.
hooks.zh: NASA 的新望远镜，要跳出狭窄视野。

hooks.en: How does the same mirror see so much more?
hooks.zh: 一样大的镜子，凭什么看得多这么多？

hooks.en: Hubble-sized mirror. Roman-sized ambitions.
hooks.zh: 哈勃大小的镜子，罗曼自己的野心。

hooks.en: The universe is speeding up. Roman wants receipts.
hooks.zh: 宇宙越胀越快，罗曼要找证据。

hooks.en: What is pushing the universe apart?
hooks.zh: 究竟是什么，在把宇宙越推越开？

hooks.en: A billion galaxies to question the darkness.
hooks.zh: 用十亿个星系，追问黑暗。

hooks.en: Roman’s target: a universe we still cannot explain.
hooks.zh: 罗曼的目标：我们仍解释不了的宇宙。

hooks.en: NASA expects a planet haul. Around 100,000.
hooks.zh: NASA 预计收获一大批行星：约十万颗。

hooks.en: The next planet hunt will have public data.
hooks.zh: 下一场找行星行动，数据向公众开放。

hooks.en: How ordinary is our planet? Roman may help answer.
hooks.zh: 地球到底有多普通？罗曼或许能帮忙回答。

hooks.en: A hundred thousand possible additions to the planet list.
hooks.zh: 行星名单，可能再添十万个名字。

hooks.en: Roman launched. Now comes the long wait for proof.
hooks.zh: 罗曼升空了，接下来等证据。

hooks.en: NASA expects 1.4 terabytes of sky a day.
hooks.zh: NASA 预计每天收到1.4TB的天空数据。

hooks.en: The rocket delivered. The universe has not answered yet.
hooks.zh: 火箭完成了交付，宇宙还没回答。

hooks.en: A new telescope, with its first images still ahead.
hooks.zh: 新望远镜已经升空，首批图像仍待到来。

hooks.en: Roman finds the crowd. Webb studies the faces.
hooks.zh: 罗曼寻找群像，韦布细看面孔。

hooks.en: What Webb can gain from a wider cosmic view.
hooks.zh: 更宽的宇宙视野，能为韦布带来什么？

hooks.en: First find something strange. Then bring in Webb.
hooks.zh: 先找到怪东西，再请韦布细看。

hooks.en: Two infrared eyes. Different questions.
hooks.zh: 两只红外眼睛，追问不同问题。

experiment.hypothesis: Untested editorial hypothesis: the visual 100x contrast increases opens; the accelerating-universe mystery increases completion and shares. Scores are editorial guesses.

x.en: Same-sized mirror. A hundred times the sky area per image. Roman’s big promise is a wider cosmic census. Its planned discoveries are still ahead.
x.zh: 镜子一样大，每张图覆盖的天空面积却约为哈勃的100倍。罗曼要做更广泛的宇宙普查。计划中的发现，仍在未来。

linkedin.en: Roman and Webb show why complementary tools matter: a broad survey can find targets for deeper inspection. Discovery starts with what your instrument lets you notice.
linkedin.zh: 罗曼和韦布说明了工具互补的价值：广泛巡天可以为深入观察寻找目标。发现，始于仪器让你看见什么。

wechat.en: A billion galaxies are a planned dataset, not a completed discovery. Roman’s survey will put our explanation of cosmic expansion under a larger test.
wechat.zh: 十亿个星系，是计划中的样本，不是已经完成的发现。罗曼的巡天，将让我们对宇宙膨胀的解释接受更大规模检验。

video.en: 0–5s: Two equal circles, one widening frame. ‘Same mirror size. A hundred times the sky area.’ 5–15s: Actual August 30 launch footage, dated. ‘NASA launched Roman. The first images were forecast for early 2027.’ 15–25s: Labeled illustration of expanding space. ‘Its surveys will ask why expansion accelerates and search for new planets.’ 25–40s: Roman and Webb labeled side by side. ‘One gives us the crowd; the other can inspect selected faces. The beautiful part is what we cannot write yet: what they will actually find.’
video.zh: 0–5秒：两个同样大的圆，画框扩展。‘镜子一样大，天空面积却是100倍。’ 5–15秒：8月30日真实发射画面，标日期。‘NASA 发射了罗曼，首批图像当时预计2027年初公开。’ 15–25秒：标明示意图的空间膨胀画面。‘它将研究宇宙为何加速膨胀，也将搜索新行星。’ 25–40秒：罗曼、韦布并列标注。‘一个寻找群像，一个细看目标。最精彩的部分，现在还写不出来：它们究竟会找到什么。’

title.en: The phishing trap was the hotel Wi-Fi.
title.zh: 钓鱼陷阱，藏在酒店 Wi-Fi 里。

summary.en: A work trip became an account-security problem.
summary.zh: 一次出差，变成了账户安全问题。

en: Anthropic’s September 10 report says an espionage operator compromised at least three hotel Wi-Fi vendors. Microsoft had described the associated CaptiveCrunch campaign in July, including AI-assisted operations and fake-update lures.
ReliaQuest documented redirects that could induce travelers to approve an attacker’s sign-in session. Merely joining Wi-Fi is not proof of account compromise.
The unsettling detail: a familiar sign-in can authorize the wrong person. Volexity documented that device-code trick in separate 2025 cases.
zh: Anthropic 9月10日的报告称，一名间谍行动操作者攻陷了至少三家酒店 Wi-Fi 服务商。微软已在7月披露相关的 CaptiveCrunch 行动，包括 AI 辅助操作及假更新诱饵。
ReliaQuest 记录的跳转可诱使旅客批准攻击者发起的登录会话。仅连接 Wi-Fi，并不能证明账户已被攻陷。
令人不安的细节是：熟悉的登录界面，也可能在给错的人授权。Volexity 在另一些2025年案例中，就记录过这种设备代码骗局。

wtf.zh: 送来诱饵的，是你所在的场所。

consequence.en: The office perimeter travels with its people.
consequence.zh: 员工走到哪里，公司的安全边界就延伸到哪里。

uncertainty.en: Vendor investigations; current campaign activity is unverified. Affected networks are not all hotel networks.
uncertainty.zh: 依据安全厂商调查；行动目前是否仍在进行，未验证。受影响网络不等于所有酒店网络。

sources.title: Anthropic: September 2026 threat intelligence report, GTG-20006
ReliaQuest: DNS poisoning expands to hospitality Wi-Fi

claims.text: Anthropic reports at least three compromised hotel Wi-Fi suppliers and combined guest/device data used for targeting.
Microsoft reports AI-assisted CaptiveCrunch activity, fake-update malware lures, and attribution to a Midnight Blizzard sub-cluster.
ReliaQuest observed hotel-network redirects, account-authorization lures without phishing email, and attacks on traveling corporate staff.
Separate Volexity cases from 2025 used genuine Microsoft device-code pages to trick users into authorizing attacker access.
Device-code authorization is a legitimate sign-in flow in which user approval enables the requesting application to receive tokens.

hooks.en: The phishing trap was the hotel Wi-Fi.
hooks.zh: 钓鱼陷阱，藏在酒店 Wi-Fi 里。

hooks.en: This phishing lure needed no email.
hooks.zh: 这次钓鱼，连邮件都不用发。

hooks.en: They targeted the employee who was traveling.
hooks.zh: 他们盯上的，是正在出差的员工。

hooks.en: A hotel connection. A corporate target.
hooks.zh: 连的是酒店网，目标却是公司账户。

hooks.en: The hotel network became the delivery route.
hooks.zh: 酒店网络，成了诱饵的配送通道。

hooks.en: Microsoft found AI behind the hotel trap.
hooks.zh: 微软发现，酒店陷阱背后有 AI 助力。

hooks.en: That update prompt had another job.
hooks.zh: 那个更新提示，另有任务。

hooks.en: Microsoft traced the hotel campaign to Russian espionage.
hooks.zh: 微软将酒店网络行动指向俄罗斯间谍组织。

hooks.en: The spy operation had AI help.
hooks.zh: 这场间谍行动，有 AI 帮忙。

hooks.en: Malware arrived dressed as an update.
hooks.zh: 恶意软件，披着更新的外衣到来。

hooks.en: Three Wi-Fi suppliers. A route to hotel guests.
hooks.zh: 三家 Wi-Fi 服务商，一条通向住客的路。

hooks.en: The guest list became targeting material.
hooks.zh: 住客资料，变成了锁定目标的材料。

hooks.en: To reach the guest, compromise the supplier.
hooks.zh: 想接近住客，先攻陷服务商。

hooks.en: Your hotel details can matter to a spy.
hooks.zh: 你的酒店资料，可能正是间谍想要的。

hooks.en: Where you stayed met what your device revealed.
hooks.zh: 住在哪里，与设备透露的信息，拼在了一起。

hooks.en: A real sign-in page. The wrong person benefits.
hooks.zh: 登录页是真的，获益的却是别人。

hooks.en: The trick was getting your approval.
hooks.zh: 骗局的关键，是拿到你的批准。

hooks.en: The login trick predates this hotel campaign.
hooks.zh: 这种登录骗局，比酒店行动更早出现。

hooks.en: A familiar login is not the whole story.
hooks.zh: 熟悉的登录界面，不是故事的全部。

hooks.en: Who is that sign-in really authorizing?
hooks.zh: 这次登录，究竟在给谁授权？

experiment.hypothesis: Untested editorial hypothesis: familiar hotel context wins opens; the real-login paradox wins shares. Measure qualified reads alongside clicks. Scores are editorial guesses.

x.en: The guest list became targeting material. Anthropic reports hotel Wi-Fi suppliers were compromised in an espionage operation. The physical trip and the digital trail met.
x.zh: 住客资料，变成了锁定目标的材料。Anthropic 报告称，酒店 Wi-Fi 服务商遭到间谍行动攻陷。现实中的行程，与数字踪迹，拼在了一起。

linkedin.en: Microsoft’s CaptiveCrunch account puts a business question on the travel agenda: how does employee security hold up outside the office?
linkedin.zh: 微软的 CaptiveCrunch 报告，把一个问题放进了差旅议程：员工离开办公室后，安全措施还能否起作用？

wechat.en: The trap can end on a genuine login page. Volexity’s separate 2025 cases show why the requester matters as much as the website.
wechat.zh: 陷阱也可能通向真正的登录页。Volexity 另一些2025年案例说明：谁在要求你登录，和你在哪个网站登录，同样关键。

video.en: 0–5s: Hotel Wi-Fi symbol. ‘The trap was where they connected.’ 5–15s: Source dates on screen. ‘July investigations described compromised hospitality networks. September reporting added details about suppliers and guest information.’ 15–25s: Abstract sign-in diagram, labeled illustration. ‘The human move mattered: a traveler could be tricked into authorizing an attacker’s session.’ 25–40s: Pause on the approval button. ‘Separate 2025 cases already showed that a real login page can serve a false request. Connection alone does not prove theft. The question is who your approval lets in.’
video.zh: 0–5秒：酒店 Wi-Fi 图标。‘陷阱，就在连接的地方。’ 5–15秒：标出来源日期。‘七月的调查描述了被攻陷的酒店网络。九月的报告补充了服务商和住客信息的细节。’ 15–25秒：标明示意图的登录流程。‘人的动作很关键：旅客可能受骗，批准攻击者发起的会话。’ 25–40秒：停在批准按钮。‘另一些2025年的案例已显示，真正的登录页也能服务于虚假请求。连接网络本身不等于被盗。关键是：你的批准，让谁进来了。’
